post.title: What is your cancellation policy?
post.html: f you need to cancel your booking, please let us know as soon as possible by emailing victoria@blacohillcottages.co.uk. spending on the time between the cancelation and the booking may result in yoru deposit being lost. Make sure you let us know with plenty of time.
